activity_code_shape.name: activity_code_shape
activity_code_shape.value:
"activity_code"."protocol" IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5) AND length("activity_code"."fingerprint") = 64 AND length("activity_code"."tests_digest") = 64
        AND ("activity_code"."network" IS NULL OR ("activity_code"."protocol" >= 2 AND json_valid("activity_code"."network")
          AND json_type("activity_code"."network") = 'array' AND json_array_length("activity_code"."network") BETWEEN 1 AND 3))
        AND length("activity_code"."prompt") <= 40
        AND typeof("activity_code"."min_each_minor") = 'integer' AND "activity_code"."min_each_minor" > 0
        AND ("activity_code"."seed_commitment" IS NULL) = ("activity_code"."seed_ciphertext" IS NULL)
        AND ("activity_code"."seed_commitment" IS NULL OR length("activity_code"."seed_commitment") = 64)
        AND typeof("activity_code"."failures_in_row") = 'integer' AND "activity_code"."failures_in_row" BETWEEN 0 AND 5
        AND typeof("activity_code"."sandbox") = 'integer' AND "activity_code"."sandbox" BETWEEN 0 AND 3
        AND ("activity_code"."stopped_at" IS NULL) = ("activity_code"."stopped_by_user_id" IS NULL)
        AND ("activity_code"."code" IS NULL) = ("activity_code"."revealed_at" IS NULL)
        AND ("activity_code"."seed" IS NULL) = ("activity_code"."revealed_at" IS NULL)
        AND ("activity_code"."seed" IS NULL OR length("activity_code"."seed") = 64)
        AND ("activity_code"."judge_version" IS NULL OR ("activity_code"."judge_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND typeof("activity_code"."judge_version") = 'integer' AND "activity_code"."judge_version" >= 1))
        AND ("activity_code"."params_public" IS NULL OR json_valid("activity_code"."params_public"))
        AND ("activity_code"."params_commitment" IS NULL) = ("activity_code"."params_salt_ciphertext" IS NULL)
        AND ("activity_code"."params_commitment" IS NULL OR length("activity_code"."params_commitment") = 64)
        AND ("activity_code"."params_secret" IS NULL) = ("activity_code"."params_salt" IS NULL)
        AND ("activity_code"."params_secret" IS NULL OR ("activity_code"."params_commitment" IS NOT NULL
          AND "activity_code"."revealed_at" IS NOT NULL AND json_valid("activity_code"."params_secret")))
        AND ("activity_code"."view_summary" IS NULL OR length("activity_code"."view_summary") BETWEEN 1 AND 200)
        AND ("activity_code"."view_data" IS NULL OR (json_valid("activity_code"."view_data") AND length(CAST("activity_code"."view_data" AS BLOB)) <= 16384))
        AND ("activity_code"."view_at" IS NULL OR ("activity_code"."protocol" >= 4 AND typeof("activity_code"."view_at") = 'integer'))
        AND (("activity_code"."view_summary" IS NULL AND "activity_code"."view_data" IS NULL) OR "activity_code"."view_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("activity_code"."setup_ciphertext" IS NULL OR "activity_code"."protocol" >= 4)
        AND typeof("activity_code"."pending_minor") = 'integer' AND "activity_code"."pending_minor" >= 0
        AND ("activity_code"."protocol" >= 5 OR ("activity_code"."pending_minor" = 0 AND "activity_code"."settled_at" IS NULL))
        AND ("activity_code"."settled_at" IS NULL OR (typeof("activity_code"."settled_at") = 'integer' AND "activity_code"."pending_minor" = 0))
